_about: Game-wide rules and numbers that aren't one hero's or enemy's. Approved changes through 25 Nov are in.

enemyScale._about: Act-wide enemy buff knobs (27 Nov): damage multiplier, attack speed bonus (0.1 = 10% faster), HP multiplier.
enemyScale._set: Luke, 27 Nov (post-cast rework + attackGrowth=1): +12% attack speed, 1.12x damage, 1.0x HP — bare dies at F3, sensible 54%, engine 65%.

evasion.note: chance an attack misses; attacks only, never abilities; pierce lowers it

attackGrowth.note: extra weapon dice per tier above 1 for heroes (Luke 26 Nov: 1; switched on 27 Nov after full 22-hero cast rework)

charge._attacker: charge per basic attack = 100 x attack interval / attackerSecondsPerCast
charge._refund: A Fizzle, or a Stun during a cast, leaves the hero with this share of their charge-to-cast.
charge._chargeToCast: Each hero needs chargeToCast charge to cast (default 100). Gains per job stay the same; a bigger number means a bigger, rarer ability.

abilityScores._modifier: half = each point above 10 is worth half a modifier point (15 gives +2.5; Luke, 26 Nov), with .5 damage, heals and Wards rounding up or down at random. floor = D&D's rounded-down modifier (15 gives +2).

shop._ownedHeroWeight: How likely a hero you already own is to be offered, next to one you don't (1 = equally likely, 0.5 = half as likely). Rerolls cost 1 gold, then 1 more for each reroll in the same shop (run.js).

dice._modes: random = normal play. average = every damage, heal, Ward and bonus die rolls its average; the d20 ability roll stays random. average-all = the d20 rolls its average too (10.5; Advantage 13.825, Disadvantage 7.175). The bench option --dice overrides this.

abilitySizes._about: Set a hero's "size"; chargeToCast sets how often it casts. castsPer30s is what the engine actually delivers at tier 1 (walking and targeting included), measured 25 Nov.

jobTargets._about: Tier 1, no items, Act 1 regular fights. fightEhp = HP x (AC + 20) / 20 plus the Ward, healing and regen the hero gives itself in a 30-second fight. dps = the hero's own damage per second after enemy armor, ability included.
jobTargets._calibrated: Frontline effective HP is anchored to the five tanks approved 24-25 Nov (about 300); brawler to Zark and Arthur (about 220-230); the rest from the Act 1 reference fight.
